hero.title: We build tools that
hero.description: A small, independent team on a simple mission: make everyday work feel lighter. No bloat, no noise — just software that does its job well.

mission.title: Software should feel like a good colleague
paragraphs: Most tools ask for more than they give back: more setup, more tabs, more meetings. We started this company because we believed the opposite was possible — a product that quietly handles the busywork so people can focus on the part only they can do.
Today that idea is used by teams in more than forty countries. We're still independent, still profitable, and still shipping every single week.

quote.text: The best compliment we get is that people forget the product is there. That's the whole design goal.
quote.author: Amara Okafor

values.title: Move fast
values.text: We ship small, focused improvements every week instead of waiting for the perfect release.

values.title: Stay simple
values.text: Great tools get out of the way. We obsess over removing steps, not adding them.

values.title: Build together
values.text: Our roadmap is shaped in the open. Customers are our best product managers.

values.title: Earn trust
values.text: Privacy first, no dark patterns, and a clear price. Your data stays yours.
